description: TickerGlass: provider budget, cache, alerts, notifications, screener and backups. See docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: API scrape
panels.description: 1 when Prometheus can scrape /metrics (job name from prometheus.example.yml).

panels.title: Alerts service
panels.description: The alerts service sends a heartbeat every 30 s; offline after 90 s.

panels.title: Upstream requests by outcome
panels.description: One count per upstream attempt, retries included.

panels.title: Refused before reaching the provider (local budget / breaker)
Circuit breaker open
panels.description: 1 = the provider is being skipped after repeated failures.

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Hits over hits plus misses, per cache.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Series waiting for data or a free slot.

panels.title: Evaluations and failures per second
panels.description: Counters reset when the alerts service restarts; rate() handles that.

panels.title: Alerts fired per second
panels.description: chart = chart and script alerts, screener = screen alerts.

panels.title: Evaluation lag (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Time between when an evaluation should happen (bar close or scheduled poll) and when it completes.

panels.title: Outbox
panels.description: Rows waiting to be sent (pending) or given up on (failed).

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Orange after 24 h, red after 36 h.

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Absent while the snapshot table is empty.

panels.title: Last run
panels.description: Time since the latest run of each kind started or finished.

panels.title: Since last success
panels.description: Orange after 36 h, red after 2 days. No value: never succeeded.

panels.title: Metric collection errors
panels.description: A section that fails to collect is skipped; the scrape itself still succeeds.

title: TickerGlass
